# CArgon2 — vendored Argon2 reference implementation (Phase 14b, R-7)

Vendored copy of the official PHC (Password Hashing Competition) reference
implementation of Argon2, used by `VariorumCore/Crypto/PassphraseKDF` for
Argon2id passphrase-key derivation (the E2EE vault's passphrase wrap —
Phase 14b ruling R-7, author-confirmed 2026-08-04: "Confirmed — Argon2id
(Recommended)"; her approval covers exactly this vendoring).

- **Upstream:** https://github.com/P-H-C/phc-winner-argon2
- **Pinned upstream commit:** `f57e61e19229e23c4445b85494dbf7c07de721cb`
  (fetched 2026-08-04; files copied byte-verbatim, zero local modifications)
- **License:** dual CC0-1.0 / Apache-2.0 at the user's option — the upstream
  `LICENSE` file is preserved verbatim beside this README. Free, no
  royalties, no copyleft; CC0 carries no notice obligation, this README is
  the notice anyway.

## Vendored file set (minimal for Argon2id, single-threaded)

Only what an Argon2id raw-hash + ctx call needs, compiled with
`ARGON2_NO_THREADS` (no pthreads; `fill_memory_blocks` runs its
single-threaded path — upstream supports this explicitly, `core.c`'s
`#if defined(ARGON2_NO_THREADS)` arm):

```
include/argon2.h            public API header (the target's public headers)
src/argon2.c                API entry points (argon2id_hash_raw, argon2_ctx, …)
src/core.c  src/core.h      the memory-filling core
src/encoding.c src/encoding.h  encoded-hash support (argon2.c links against it)
src/ref.c                   reference (portable) fill_segment — no SIMD variant
src/thread.h                header only; internals self-guarded by
                            ARGON2_NO_THREADS, so thread.c is NOT vendored
src/blake2/blake2.h  blake2-impl.h  blake2b.c  blamka-round-ref.h
                            BLAKE2b + the reference BLAMKA round
```

Deliberately NOT vendored: `opt.c`/`blamka-round-opt.h` (SSE/AVX x86 path —
we ship the portable `ref.c` on Apple silicon), `thread.c` (excluded by
`ARGON2_NO_THREADS`), `bench.c`, `genkat.c`/`genkat.h` (KAT generator; its
`core.c` include sites are `#ifdef GENKAT`-guarded and never compiled),
`run.c`, `test.c`, kats/, and all build machinery.

## Wiring

`Package.swift` defines the `CArgon2` C target over this directory
(`publicHeadersPath: "include"`, `-DARGON2_NO_THREADS`, header search path
`src`); `VariorumCore` depends on it. Swift call sites import `CArgon2`.

## Verification

`Tests/VariorumCoreTests/PassphraseKDFTests.swift` pins the vendored build
against the RFC 9106 §5.3 Argon2id test vector (identical to the pinned
upstream's own `kats/argon2id` KAT — the RFC vectors were generated by this
reference implementation) plus the upstream `src/test.c` argon2id raw-API
vectors. Do not touch these files except to re-vendor at a newer pinned
commit — and then update this README's pin in the same commit.
